recipe.visualDefinition: A central oval cameo containing a group portrait of five individuals in mid-20th-century attire, set against a dense green foliage backdrop. The oval is framed by a gold rope border and flanked by a vibrant blue sea filled with stylized, spouting whales and a distant cityscape under a rising sun.
coreVisualRelationships: The central oval frame acts as a portal between a realistic portrait and a surreal maritime environment.
The bright blue of the ocean contrasts sharply with the earthy greens and browns inside the cameo.
The stylized, cartoon-like whales in the background juxtapose with the somber, realistic expressions of the human subjects.
coreInvariants: Stylized water ripples with white-capped spouts
Distant city skyline on the horizon
Arched banner typography at top and bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five people (four men, one woman) occupies the central 60% of the vertical space within the oval.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central man in the dark blazer and flat cap serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular rope frame, moving from the top banner down to the bottom banner, then inward to the faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue ocean provides significant negative space on the left and right, balancing the dense detail of the central portrait.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue defines the sea and sky background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep forest green provides the backdrop for the figures inside the oval.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and red are used for the sun rays and the text banners.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the environment (blue/yellow) contrasts with the desaturated, muted tones of the subjects' clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Letters are arched to follow the curve of the banners
Yellow fill with a thin red outline and black drop shadow
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' has a deep center V reaching the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single consistent typeface used for both top and bottom banners to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Halftone-like stippling on the water ripples

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist painting of a blue ocean with stylized spouting whales and a distant city skyline. In the center, place a large oval frame made of golden rope. Inside the frame, paint a group of five people in 1940s-style clothing standing in front of dark green leaves. Add a yellow sun with rays in the top left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two arched red banners with green borders at the top and bottom of the oval. Place bold, yellow, slab-serif uppercase text inside these banners, following the curve.

verificationChecks: Is the rope border clearly defined?
Are the whales spouting white water?
Is the text arched correctly within the banners?
Is the color palette dominated by cerulean and forest green?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the portrait
Density of whales in the water
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Specific wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rope texture is visible on the oval frame.
Check that the sun rays do not overlap the central portrait.
Verify the whales have a consistent, simplified illustrative style.
Confirm the text has a visible black drop shadow for legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a realistic central cameo portrait with a surreal, highly-saturated maritime environment, framed by nautical elements and arched slab-serif typography.
